quests.title: Kurious Kamera

dialogue.t: How very strange... What is the matter with this Kamera?
I think it's broken... Well, maybe not broken, but it's certainly not working like it's supposed to.
I ordered a batch from Fontaine a while back.
The person who sold it to me said that this particular kind of Kamera features the very latest technology from Fontaine.
Supposedly, it can print photos in a special hue and add in some special effects, or something. So I bought one to try it out.
But try as I might, I can't get it to print out photos properly. I don't know whether I'm using it wrong, or if it's just faulty.
Maybe there's some trick to it that I'm not getting...
So, how about you? Much of a Kamera Konnoisseur yourself?

dialogue.sit: Never heard of a "Kamera" in my life.

dialogue.t: I'll take that as a yes! So, could I get you to help?
I'm guessing you're a traveler? You must have a lot of experiences under your belt.
What I'd like you to do is use this Kamera to take a picture of something with a strong color.
Once you've taken a snap, if you could please bring me the photo. I want to see if I can isolate the source of the issue...
And if I can't, I'll take the photos to the seller and see what he has to say. With the photos as hard evidence, he won't be able to dismiss the issue.

dialogue.sit: What do you mean by strong color?

quests.description: A certain special Kamera is currently causing Ji Tong some grief…
